mikko by hako

mikko: みっ from みっつ, “three,” plus こ, a small, friendly ending. It rhymes with hako.

$69.99 planned price

Three walnut keys in a block of walnut, made for reviewing in Anki and Migaku: Again, Good and Undo out of the box, and you can remap all three. A switch on the front picks Bluetooth, USB-C cable or the 2.4 GHz receiver. No power switch: it sleeps when you stop and wakes on the first press.

Tell me when it's ready

Coming after hako. Leave your email below and I'll write when it's ready.

Keys
Three, in solid walnut: Again, Good and Undo, all remappable
Body

Connects
Bluetooth, a USB-C cable or the 2.4 GHz USB receiver, picked with a switch on the front
Power
Rechargeable over USB-C. Sleeps when idle and wakes on the first press

Works with
